facts.fact: Gozem, a Lomé-based super app, closed a $30m Series B round in February 2025 with support from MSC Group and Al Mada Ventures; the document does not give the investors' home countries.

The International Finance Corporation, a development finance institution, supported Gozem, a Lomé-based super app, with a $10m commitment; the document gives no date for it, so its published date 2026-03 is used.
